field_notes.structure: Two-axis rank system: aps_heroes_rankLv defines 8 Commander Rank Levels (0-7); aps_heroes_rank defines 70 Hero Rank Stages (id 1-70, levels 1-18).
field_notes.rank_levels: Commander earns Rank Level 0-7 (Private/2nd Lt/1st Lt/Captain/Major/Brigadier/General/Marshal). Each level multiplies hero rank bonuses by hero squad slot position.
field_notes.slot_bonuses: slot_atk_pct/slot_def_pct/slot_troop_pct: multipliers (%) applied to hero rank base atk/def/troop. slot_1 > slot_2 > slot_3 > slot_4 (lead hero gets biggest bonus).
field_notes.rank_stages: 70 hero rank stages organized into 18 rank level groups. Each group has 4-5 stages. Stage 4 (or stage 0 for lv=1) marks a rank level completion point.
field_notes.profession: Each hero rank stage defines separate values for 3 professions. prof_1=Military Officer (max rank: Marshal lv18, max atk 700%), prof_2=Tech Officer (max atk 500%), prof_3=Development Officer (max rank: lv=14/stage=1, then atk stagnates; effectively capped at lv13 for progression cost).
field_notes.atk_def_pct: Cumulative percentage bonus to troop ATK and DEF (not deltas). Must be multiplied by commander rank slot_atk_pct to get effective bonus.
field_notes.troop_cap_pct: Cumulative percentage bonus to troop capacity.
field_notes.cost: require_hero_lv: minimum hero level needed for this rank stage. cost_medals: Military Rank Medals. cost_coins: Gold. require=0 means not available for that profession.
field_notes.skill_slot: skill_slot_by_prof: which squad skill slot (1-4) activates at this rank stage completion (stage 4 only). Cycles 1->2->3->4->1->2->3->4 per rank level group.
field_notes.power: atk/def/troop bonuses are percentage multipliers, not absolute values. Power contribution is indirect (affects combat through squad formation).
field_notes.formula: effective_atk_bonus_% = hero_rank_atk_pct * commander_slot_atk_pct / 100. E.g., hero atk=700% at Marshal + Commander rank Marshal slot1 (150%) = 700*150/100 = 1050% effective ATK bonus.
field_notes.locale: Rank names (Reservist, 2nd Lieutenant, Colonel, Marshal etc.) resolved via LEB128-encoded locale. Both hero rank stages and commander rank levels have distinct name sets.
